notes: comms.md is empty: Seb made no calls or emails, so K7 has no opportunities. No head was ever powered (no socket anywhere), so K5 has none and the strip-spec claim is unclear. Lampatronics' 'within an hour' joining claim is counted under K1 only (the brief lists it as a K1 example), not also under K4. Seb's stand counts were totals across shops, so a shop with fewer stands than the total was not counted as K2 'fewer units'. The 12V-module ask (20) is false even though Seb later wanted 32. Seb's requests for lit photos (file-000013, -000028) were requests for a test, not photo redos. The two Sunday return rides come from chat times only (booking to arrival), with pickup wait included; the other actual times are from the log.
